CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DEP] AS 
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct AS 
(
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BDG.ACCT_OPN_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDG.ACCT_CLS_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,BDG.SCHM_CODE AS ProductId
	,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
	,NULL AS CommitmentId
	,BDG.SCHM_TYPE AS FcbsApplication
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG WHERE BDG.ISLATEST = 1 
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(date,PeriodStartDate)
,convert(varchar,ProductId)
,convert(varchar,IsoCurrencyCode)
,convert(varchar,FcbsApplication)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, ProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(date,PeriodStartDate)
,convert(varchar,ProductId)
,convert(varchar,IsoCurrencyCode)
,convert(varchar,FcbsApplication)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, ProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
	,ISNULL(SRC.ProductId,TGT.ProductId) AS ProductId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	convert(varchar,SRC.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,TGT.CustomerAccountId)
AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
AND SRC.ProductId = TGT.ProductId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
--SELECT TOP 10 * FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA WHERE CustomerAccountId = '78bd43110d0bbfdcd3d993d34f92a4ed'

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate  AND DELTA.ProductId = TGT.ProductId  AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode  AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate AND SRC.ProductId = TGT.ProductId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.ProductId AS ProductId
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,SRC.FcbsApplication AS FcbsApplication
,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate AND DELTA.ProductId = SRC.ProductId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT','UPDATE') ;

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
GO
